description: Lambda deployment package size budgets (MB), enforced by scripts/track-lambda-size.mjs. Unzipped is the production dependency tree + source that scripts/deploy-lambda.sh zips into function.zip; zipped is the function.zip size. AWS Lambda limits are 250 MB unzipped / 50 MB zipped. Budgets carry ~40% headroom over observed sizes so normal dependency growth is allowed but a heavy-dependency regression (e.g. a new SDK, a transitive bloat) fails the check before it breaks deploys. Raise a budget only when a service grows for a justified reason.
